explanation: Maintain the item stack and a second stack of running maxima, retaining repeated maximum occurrences.
correctness: Each stored maximum equals the maximum of the matching stack prefix. Push extends that invariant and Pop restores the preceding prefix; GetMax simply reads it.
walkthrough: Push 5, then 9. The auxiliary maximum stack records both increases, so GetMax returns 9. Pop removes 9 from both stacks. The remaining maximum is 5, and the next GetMax reads it without removing it. Equal maxima would each need a retained occurrence as well.
timeComplexity: O(1) amortized time for Push and O(1) time for Pop and GetMax, using Java array-backed stacks.
spaceComplexity: O(p) retained storage for peak p live items.
